title: 第3章 虎落平阳狗不可欺第4章 谭平
lines: “国王陛下？”
听到这熟悉的称呼，江来看着在场的十多名白种男子，嘴角微微翘起，桀骜不驯的脸庞上露出嘲弄的笑容，“不用假惺惺的了，如果真当我是你们的国王，刚才又何必偷袭我。”
一名身材臃肿，脸有刀疤的白种男子慢慢站起身，沉声道：“您是我们曾经的王，但现在新王继位，我们自然要服从新任国王的命令。他希望您死，我们只能照做。您应该感到庆幸，这里是华国，枪支管制太严，不然的话，刚才您早已经被一枪毙命。”
江来嘴角微扬，神情淡然：“华国有句古话说得好，虎落平阳被犬欺，只不过，就算我再落魄，也轮不到你们这群狗来欺负。”
刀疤男神色一冷，厉声道：“本来想给您一个痛快，既然您不肯配合，那就别怪我们不念旧情了，杀！”
一声令下，十多名白种男子纷纷掏出藏在腰间的匕首，游走在江来的周围，慢慢逼近。身为他们曾经的王，无论是谁，都心存忌惮，不敢有丝毫大意，因为他们很清楚自己面对的敌人是谁。
眼看着众人步步迫近，江来神情漠然，双臂自然的垂落，身姿笔挺，站在原地一动不动。骤然间，他腰身微微弓起，犹如一道离弦之箭，迅速往前冲了去，转眼便到了一名白种人的身前。
“喀嚓！”
清脆的响声传来，众人惊骇的发现，在电光火石之间，自己的同伴已经被扭断脖颈，瘫倒在地上。
一击得手，江来脚尖转动，双腿猛地发力，身体高高跃起，飞身扑进人群，仿佛虎入羊群，大杀四方，惨叫声更是此起彼伏。眨眼间的功夫，已经有近半的白种人被当场格杀。
面对江来的疯狂而残暴的攻势，没有人是他一合之敌。不仅仅是因为他的实力，更令人畏惧的是他那一往无前，不死不休的气势。
传闻中，他们这位曾经的王在战场上无往不利，手段狠辣血腥，但凡他的敌人，都被撕成粉碎，无一活口，没有人能阻挡他前进的脚步。如今，他们总算彻身体会到这位大魔王的凶残和可怕。
看着手下一个个倒在血泊中，刀疤男的身体不自觉的颤抖起来，脸色惨白得像一张纸，握刀的手心早已被汗水浸湿。
当那张冷峻漠然的脸庞在瞳孔中慢慢放大，刀疤男忍不住咽了口唾沫，整个人仿佛被抽干了力气，连手臂都抬不起来了，一股寒意瞬间从脚底蔓延全身。
“我不杀你，回去告诉安德鲁，那张王座先让他享受几天，迟早有一天我会重新夺回来，滚！”
刀疤男浑身一颤，如蒙大赦，跌跌撞撞的狼狈而逃，驾车离去。
看了眼地上横七竖八的尸体，江来收起眼中的森冷，转身回到了面包车上。这些尸体自会有人处理，他不用操心会留下痕迹。
坐在驾驶座上，听着后车座传来的呼吸声，江来沉默了一会，嘴角突然扬起一道弧线，笑容玩味。随后，他发动引擎，径直往市区方向驶去。
十多分钟后，江来找了个地方停好车，然后回头看着那仍在熟睡中的女人，道：“别装了，起来吧。”刚刚上车的时候，他就从对方不均匀的呼吸声中察觉到了，只是没有点破而已。虽然她很努力的掩饰，可惜还是骗不过经验丰富的他。
然而，那女人对他的话充耳不闻，依然躺在车座上。
江来见状，声音陡地变冷，“你要是再装睡，信不信我立刻杀了你。”
“别！我……我起来了。”女人一个激灵坐起身，蜷缩着双腿，一张脸庞隐藏在披散的长发下，低着头，娇躯瑟瑟发抖。
看到对方畏惧的模样，江来似笑非笑的问道：“你都看到了？”
“看……不！我……我什么都没看到。”女人把头埋得更低了。
“真的？那你为什么不敢抬头看我，难道怕我窥视你的美色，把你吃了不成。你最好老实交代，不然的话……”江来发出一阵意味深长的笑声。
女人纠结了一下，支支吾吾道：“只要我没看清你长什么样，你……你就不会害我，所以我……”
“所以你不敢看我？”江来无奈道：“你这都是从哪学来的？如果我真想杀你的话，早就动手了。”
“你不杀我？”女人微微偏头，露出一双明亮的美眸。
江来枕着双手，双腿吊儿郎当的搭在副驾驶前，慢悠悠道：“你跟我无冤无仇，我为什么要杀你。更何况，我刚刚只是正当防卫，就算警察抓了我也只能无罪释放。行了，赶紧回家吧，以后别一个人去酒吧，免得被人劫财劫色。”
透过后视镜，看着假寐中的江来，女人犹豫了一下，然后小心翼翼的推开车门，举步往外走去。
“哎呀！”
双脚刚一落地，也许是体内的药力还未完全消退，她只觉浑身发软，两条腿一点力气都没有，身体不受控制的往旁边倒去。就在这时，一只强有力的手臂从车窗中探了出来，扶住了她的胳膊。
“小心点。”
声音传来，她转过头，正好接触到那双深邃的瞳仁。四目相对，江来终于看清楚眼前这个女人的长相，目光不由一亮。
一张精美的瓜子脸蛋，肤色白皙，两道纤细的叶儿眉，双瞳剪水，清澈明亮，秀挺的鼻梁下，是两片如樱桃般小巧诱人的薄唇，粉粉嫩嫩，让人忍不住生出想要咬一口的冲动。
“谢谢你！”
对方轻咬着薄唇，细弱蚊吟道。说完，她别过头，美眸闪烁，不知道在思考什么。过了一会，她咬了咬牙，再次把美眸转向江来，眼神坚定，仿佛下定了决心般，开口问道：“你……可以送我回去吗？”
“送你回去？”江来没想到她会提出这种要求，失笑道：“美女，路上那么多计程车，你随便叫一辆就行了。再说了，让我送你回去，难道你就不怕我对你图谋不轨？”
“我不怕。”女人摇摇头道：“如果你想对我不利，干嘛要让我离开。另外，我想跟你谈一桩生意。”
“没兴趣！”江来毫不客气的回绝道：“我现在不太喜欢跟女人打交道，尤其是你这种漂亮的女人。”
content_en:
"Your Majesty the King?"
Hearing this familiar title, Jiang Lai looked at the dozen or so white men present, with the corners of his mouth raised slightly, and a mocking smile on his unruly face. "No need to be pretentious. If you really think that I am your king, why did you attack me just now?"
A bloated Caucasian man with a scar on his face slowly stood up and said in a deep voice: "You were our former king, but now that the new king has succeeded, we naturally have to obey the new king's orders. He wants you to die, so we can only do it. You should feel lucky that this is China and gun control is too strict. Otherwise, you would have been shot to death just now."
Jiang Lai raised the corner of his mouth slightly and said with an indifferent expression: "There is an old saying in the Chinese country that a tiger will be bullied by a dog when it falls flat. However, no matter how miserable I am, it will not be your turn to be bullied by dogs."
The scarred man's expression turned cold and he said sternly: "I originally wanted to give you a pleasure, but since you refuse to cooperate, don't blame us for not remembering our old relationship, kill!"
At the command, more than a dozen white men took out the daggers hidden in their waists and wandered around Jiang Lai, slowly approaching. As their former king, no matter who they were, they were all wary and did not dare to be careless at all, because they knew very well who the enemy they faced was.
Seeing the crowd approaching step by step, Jiang Lai looked indifferent, his arms dropped naturally, his posture was straight, and he stood motionless. Suddenly, his waist slightly arched, like an arrow from the string, he rushed forward quickly, and in a blink of an eye he was in front of a white man.
"Crack!"
A crisp sound came, and everyone was horrified to find that in the flash of lightning, their companion's neck had been broken and he collapsed on the ground.
After a successful attack, Jiang Lai turned on his toes, exerted force on his legs, leaped high into the air, and flew into the crowd, as if a tiger had entered the flock of sheep, killing everyone in all directions, and screams came one after another. In the blink of an eye, nearly half of the white people had been killed on the spot.
Faced with Jiang Lai's crazy and brutal offensive, no one was his enemy. Not only because of his strength, but what is even more terrifying is his indomitable and unrelenting momentum.
According to rumors, their former king was invincible on the battlefield and his methods were ruthless and bloody. All his enemies were torn to pieces, leaving no one alive. No one could stop his progress. Now, they finally fully understand the ferocity and terror of this great devil.
Seeing his men fall into a pool of blood one by one, the scarred man's body trembled unconsciously, his face was as pale as a piece of paper, and the palm of his hand holding the knife was already soaked with sweat.
When the cold and indifferent face slowly enlarged in the pupils, the scarred man couldn't help but swallowed. His whole body seemed to have been drained of strength, and he couldn't even lift his arms. A chill instantly spread from the soles of his feet to his whole body.
"I won't kill you. Go back and tell Andrew. Let him enjoy the throne for a few days. Sooner or later, I will take it back. Get out!"
The scarred man trembled all over, as if he had been granted amnesty, he stumbled away and drove away.
After looking at the corpses scattered on the ground, Jiang Lai put away the coldness in his eyes and turned back to the van. These corpses will be taken care of, so he doesn't have to worry about leaving traces.
Sitting in the driver's seat, listening to the breathing coming from the back seat, Jiang Lai was silent for a while, then the corner of his mouth suddenly raised an arc with a playful smile. Then, he started the engine and drove straight towards the city.
More than ten minutes later, Jiang found a place to park the car, then looked back at the woman who was still sleeping and said, "Stop pretending, get up." When he just got in the car, he noticed the woman's uneven breathing, but he didn't notice it. Although she tried hard to hide it, she still couldn't deceive the experienced man.
However, the woman turned a deaf ear to his words and remained lying on the car seat.
When Jiang Lai saw this, his voice suddenly turned cold, "If you pretend to be asleep again, believe it or not, I will kill you immediately."
"Don't! I...I'm up." The woman sat up with a start, curled up her legs, her face was hidden under her long disheveled hair, her head was lowered, and her delicate body was trembling.
Seeing the fearful look on the other side, Jiang Lai asked with a half-smile, "Have you seen it all?"
"Look...no! I...I didn't see anything." The woman buried her head lower.
"Really? Then why don't you dare to look up at me? Are you afraid that I will peek at your beauty and eat you up? You'd better tell the truth, otherwise..." Jiang Lai let out a meaningful laugh.
The woman struggled for a moment and hesitated: "As long as I don't see clearly what you look like, you... you won't hurt me, so I..."
"So you don't dare to look at me?" Jiang Lai said helplessly: "Where did you learn this? If I really wanted to kill you, I would have done it long ago."
"You won't kill me?" The woman tilted her head slightly, revealing a pair of bright beautiful eyes.
Jiang Lai rested his hands on his head and swung his legs in front of the co-pilot. He said slowly: "You have no grievances against me, so why should I kill you? What's more, I was just acting in self-defense. Even if the police catch me, I can only be acquitted. Okay, go home quickly, and don't go to the bar alone in the future, so as not to be robbed of your money and sex."
Looking at Jiang Lai who was sleeping through the rearview mirror, the woman hesitated for a moment, then carefully opened the car door and walked out.
"Ouch!"
As soon as her feet landed on the ground, perhaps because the medicine in her body had not completely subsided, she felt that her whole body was weak, her legs had no strength at all, and her body fell to the side uncontrollably. At this moment, a strong arm reached out from the car window and held her arm.
"Be careful."
When the voice came, she turned her head, just in time to come into contact with those deep pupils. Their eyes met, Jiang Lai finally saw clearly the appearance of the woman in front of him, and his eyes couldn't help but shine.
She has a beautiful oval face, fair complexion, two slender eyebrows, clear and bright pupils, and under the straight bridge of her nose are two small and attractive thin lips like cherries, pink and tender, making people want to take a bite.
"Thank you!"
The other party bit his thin lips lightly and moaned softly. After saying that, she turned her head away, her beautiful eyes twinkling, and she didn't know what she was thinking. After a while, she gritted her teeth and turned her beautiful eyes to Jiang Lai again. Her eyes were firm, as if she had made up her mind, and she asked, "You...can you take me back?"
"Send you back?" Jiang Lai didn't expect that she would make such a request, so he laughed and said: "Beauty, there are so many taxis on the road, just call one. Besides, let me take you back, aren't you afraid that I will do something wrong to you?"
"I'm not afraid." The woman shook her head and said, "If you want to be disadvantageous to me, why do you want me to leave? In addition, I want to discuss a business with you."
"Not interested!" Jiang Lai refused unceremoniously: "I don't really like dealing with women now, especially a beautiful woman like you."
title_en: Chapter 3: A tiger falls in Pingyang and a dog cannot be bullied Chapter 4: Tan Ping
